early.name: Quicksilver Reload
early.annotation: Even more healing and damage just like Mystic Burst. The second you get this you can start making aggressive health trades.

early.name: Trophy Collector
early.annotation: Overall sprint speed, once you have this you need to be perma-fighting anytime you have Combo up. Alternatively get Enduring Speed if you need slow resist.

mid.name: Torment Pulse
mid.annotation: Large source of your damage and helps with farm, lane clear, and tick dmg overall. Can rush Compress Cooldown here if your ult just went on cooldown.

mid.name: Healbane
mid.annotation: Good if you just need a cheap antiheal and if no one else is buying it its good to get since they dont stack with other Healbanes.

mid.name: Superior Duration
mid.annotation: Good item for just about everything right now, but the downside is your spin gets increased too, and that can hurt you in some situations. Good if your team needs an ult bot.

late.name: Tankbuster
late.annotation: Consistent 15% of your damage by end game. Obviously does more damage to higher health targets so prioritize them if just looking for heals. You need 165 Scorn damage to proc this.

late.name: Boundless Spirit
late.annotation: This should literally be the LAST item you buy, like literally full build upgrade kind of item.

late.name: Arctic Blast
late.annotation: Good for slow and the fact it completely stops movement and casting movement abilities. Makes proccing Spirit Burn trivially easy. MORE CC IS SUPER GOOD. Use right after ult to counter movement.

late.name: Escalating Exposure
late.annotation: This is what allows your damage to scale late game if they're buying resists, but it is not completely necessary. Very nice against spirit heavy comps. Works best with Spirit Burn.

late.name: Scourge
late.annotation: AMAZING active item that gives huge spirit resist, and more AOE damage. Kind of presses you for active slots but well worth it for the extra percentage-based damage.

late.name: Witchmail
late.annotation: Good for against FULL spirit teams, really a necessity buy if pressed for slots. Good against Infernus, Bebop, Geist, Lash etc.

late.name: Transcendent Cooldown
late.annotation: Buy if you have full active slots since this will lower the cooldown on them.

picks.name: Boundless Spirit
picks.annotation: This should literally be the LAST item you buy, like literally full build upgrade kind of item.

picks.name: Witchmail
picks.annotation: Good for against FULL spirit teams, really a necessity buy if pressed for slots. Good against Infernus, Bebop, Geist, Lash etc.

picks.name: Escalating Exposure
picks.annotation: This is what allows your damage to scale late game if they're buying resists, but it is not completely necessary. Very nice against spirit heavy comps. Works best with Spirit Burn.

picks.name: Scourge
picks.annotation: AMAZING active item that gives huge spirit resist, and more AOE damage. Kind of presses you for active slots but well worth it for the extra percentage-based damage.

picks.name: Spirit Burn
picks.annotation: Late game you're able to proc this with just a Burrow & Scorn so this has some potential as a strong antiheal. Works best with Escalating Exposure.

picks.name: Transcendent Cooldown
picks.annotation: Buy if you have full active slots since this will lower the cooldown on them.

picks.name: Arctic Blast
picks.annotation: Good for slow and the fact it completely stops movement and casting movement abilities. Makes proccing Spirit Burn trivially easy. MORE CC IS SUPER GOOD. Use right after ult to counter movement.

picks.name: Greater Expansion
picks.annotation: Good for all aspects of the hero, also increases item ranges, Torment Pulse, Warp Stone, Phantom Strike, etc. GET AN ARMOR!!!

picks.name: Phantom Strike
picks.annotation: Instant gap closer and a disarm, perfect for fliers/Lash since it has crazy range. Rush over Warp Stone if dealing with lots of movers.

picks.name: Tankbuster
picks.annotation: Consistent 15% of your damage by end game. Obviously does more damage to higher health targets so prioritize them if just looking for heals. You need 165 Scorn damage to proc this.

picks.name: Plated Armor
picks.annotation: Probably the best possible item for dealing with gun heroes. Especially for the ones that apply effects. Bullet Resilience is a cheaper alternative.
